_note: v3 schematic prototype board for build_board.py --type mat. PLACEHOLDER layout (labelled zones) for the Screentop prototype; the real illustrated Taiwan map is a bg-infodesign / illustration task. Region colours are first-pass night-market (identity.md), CVD-checked via check_access.py. Regions sit on a RING: North-Central-South-East-back to North; the HSR spine links North<->South down the west coast (they count adjacent). The board also carries the Season end-timer, the Prestige (score) track, the Reputation track with milestones, the tiered Vendor Board (3 rows), and each region's Market slots. Tracks/board rows are rendered separately by build_board --type track in make.sh; this mat shows the map + the layout callouts.
title: Travel Agents: Taiwan  —  four regions on the ring (v3 vendor-courting engine)

zones.label: North 北  (beef / pork / chicken / egg)  ·  Market: 4 slots
Central 中  (tea / tapioca pearls)  ·  Market: 3 slots
East 東  (rice / mountain greens)  ·  Market: 3 slots
VENDOR BOARD  —  3 face-up rows: Marquee 名店 / Eatery 小吃 / Stall 攤 (2p: 3 per tier). Court to sign; refill from that tier's deck.
SEASON end-timer  —  +1 per Court (any agent). Final mark ~16 courts (2p) -> wind-down.
PRESTIGE (score) track  0-42  —  a vendor's stars, live.
REPUTATION track  —  milestones 3 / 6 / 9 (one-time perks) and top 12 (endgame trigger).
REPUTATION end-VP  3->+2  6->+4  9->+6  top 12->+9   ·   COVERAGE end-VP  2 regions->2  3->5  all 4->9
